messages:
michelle: Quick thread: Sales pushed back requesting a lighter-weight "Optimize Advisor" for pilot customers. They want immediate, low-risk recs: batch size, simple cache hints, and three quant profiles. Also asked for eval-alerts integration but that's secondary. Can we scope a 4-week alpha?

ben: Agree to recommendations-only alpha. No automatic infra changes. Expose via Console + API + a tiny CLI export.

zara: Batching approach: sample recent requests (10k window) -> compute token-length distribution -> pick batch size at the 75th percentile target while limiting added queue time to <=50ms. We'll return one recommended size and rationale.

michelle: Acceptance targets: pilot customers should be able to reduce token spend by >=8% on median routes without p99 latency growing by >10%. Eval-alert alpha should detect regressions within 24h.

omar: Caching: return candidate prefix hints (first-16, header tokens) with TTL buckets (30s, 5m, 1h) and a conservative estimated hit rate (from sampled repetition). For alpha we ship a CLI estimator instead of a simulation UI.

zara: Quant profiles: ship `speed`, `balanced`, `accurate`. Map to docs by rough model class, but don't auto-apply. Warn strongly about A/B testing and pinning.

michelle: Security note: ensure no raw request bodies leave customer infra. Sampling/estimation should run on redacted logs or in-org.

product-bot: checklist: feature-flag `advisor-alpha`, telemetry events `advisor.view` and `advisor.export`, RBAC: monitor creation restricted to org-admins.

michelle: Owners and rough plan: frontend panel (zara) 1.5w, backend sampler + endpoints (ben) 2w, CLI estimator (omar) 1w, eval-alert plumbing PoC (omar) 1w, docs + pilot runbook (michelle) 0.5w. Target: alpha to pilots in 4 sprints (8 weeks) but try to compress to 4 weeks if we parallelize.

zara: To reduce scope: ship a single batch-size recommendation and defer percentile toggles + hit-rate UI.

ben: I'll draft the HTTP response schema and a small RFC tonight. Example: {"route":"/generate","batch_recommendation":{"size":"12","rationale":"75th pct token length"},"cache_recs":[{"prefix":"first-16","ttl":"5m","est_hit_rate":"9%"}],"quant_profile":"balanced"}

michelle: Action items: zara mockups by Thu -> #design-review; ben RFC + stub endpoint by Tue; omar CLI alpha by next Wed; michelle pilot invites + quickstart by Mon. I'll file the epic `OPT-ADVISOR-ALPHA`.

product-bot: Reminder: link this thread in the epic and set pilot flag to opt-in only.

omar: lgtm

zara: :thumbsup:

michelle: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the Jira epic and attach timelines.
